
❯ /model
  ⎿  Set model to Opus 5.5 (1M context) for this session only with xhigh effort

❯ /effort max
  ⎿  Set effort level to max (this session only): Maximum capability with deepest
     reasoning. May use excessive tokens resulting in long response times or overthinking.
     Use sparingly for the hardest tasks.

❯ /effort high
  ⎿  Set effort level to high (saved as your default for new sessions): Comprehensive
     implementation with extensive testing and documentation

❯ /model
  ⎿  Kept model as Opus 5.5 (1M context)

❯ /model

──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Select model
  Switch between Claude models. Your pick becomes the default for new sessions. For
  other/previous model names, specify with --model.

    1. Default (recommended)  Use the default model (currently Opus 5.5 (1M context)) ·
                              $4/$20 per Mtok
  ❯ 2. Opus (1M context) ✔    Opus 5.5 with 1M context · Best for everyday, complex
                              tasks · $4/$20 per Mtok
    3. Fable                  Fable 5.1 · Most capable for your hardest and
                              longest-running tasks · $10/$50 per Mtok
    4. Sonnet                 Sonnet 5 · Efficient for routine tasks · $2/$10 per Mtok
    5. Haiku                  Haiku 4.5 · Fastest for quick answers · $1/$5 per Mtok

  ● High effort ←/→ to adjust

  Enter to set as default · s to use this session only · Esc to cancel
